entries.description: The level a stored value is asked to use (СжатиеДанных). New DataCompression() leaves it at -1, the platform default. New DataCompression(level) takes -1 or 0..9; anything else is a refusal: "DataCompression: level N is outside -1..9". CompressionLevel reads the level back. 0 stores the value as it is.
entries.parameters: level - a number from -1 to 9. Left out, it is -1.
